title: Backups
description: restic backups on the hosts where they are on: when the last good backup was, whether the database dumps worked, and whether the repository is intact.

list.name: client
list.label: Client
list.description: Your Org only ever shows your own environment.

panels.title: Hosts backed up
panels.description: Hosts where the backup service is on.

panels.title: Last run failed
panels.description: Hosts whose most recent backup run did not complete.

panels.title: Oldest last backup
panels.description: The longest any selected host has gone without a successful backup. Orange past a day, red past two.

panels.title: Stored in repositories
panels.description: Size of the backup repositories on disk, deduplicated and compressed. Hosts that share one repository count it once each.

panels.title: Dumps failing
panels.description: Databases whose dump failed in the last run.

panels.title: Schedules and their last backup
panels.description: What each host backs up and when. Click a row — the last backup, or any other column — to point the panels below at that schedule.

panels.title: Add a schedule
panels.description: Creates a schedule. The host's agent picks it up within a minute and runs it from then on.

elements.title: Client
Host
elements.tooltip: The hosts whose agents ask this API for work — the ones that can back up.

elements.title: Name
elements.tooltip: Short name, e.g. nightly. Unique per host.

elements.title: Cron
elements.tooltip: Five fields, in the agent's timezone (UTC).

elements.title: Machine
elements.tooltip: Back up the whole filesystem, minus the obvious throwaways.

elements.title: Paths
elements.tooltip: One absolute path per line, e.g. /etc/nginx

elements.title: Volumes
elements.tooltip: One Docker volume name per line.

elements.title: Databases
elements.tooltip: One name per line, matching a DB_<NAME> variable on the agent.

confirmModal.title: Confirm
confirmModal.body: Please confirm to update changed values

panels.title: Backups of ${bschedule} ${bhost}
panels.description: Every backup of the schedule selected above, newest first. With nothing selected, every backup the agents have reported.

panels.title: Restore a backup
panels.description: Pick a backup and put it back. Nothing is written over: the restore lands beside the live data and only switches once it has finished, keeping what was there as _old_<timestamp>.

elements.title: Backup
elements.tooltip: The backups of the schedule selected above, newest first.

elements.title: Only path
elements.tooltip: Optional, for file backups: put back just this path out of the backup.

elements.title: Switch over
elements.tooltip: Restore beside the live data and switch over once it has finished, keeping what was there as <name>_old_<timestamp>. Off leaves the copy beside it.

confirmModal.title: Confirm
confirmModal.body: Please confirm to update changed values

panels.title: Recent actions
panels.description: Backups and restores asked for from here, and what came back.

panels.title: Back up now
panels.description: Runs a schedule immediately on its host, without waiting for its cron.

elements.title: Schedule
elements.tooltip: Runs this schedule now, outside its cron.

confirmModal.title: Confirm
confirmModal.body: Please confirm to update changed values

panels.title: Backup duration
panels.description: How long each run took, from start to the end of the check.

panels.title: New data per run
panels.description: What each run added to the repository after deduplication: the real daily change.

panels.title: Repository size
panels.description: Grows with new data, shrinks when retention removes old snapshots.
